notes: NSH GTK4 backend (Rust-only app, no QuickJS). Frame end = GdkFrameClock after-paint on the GTK main thread (GSK render finished on CPU, X11 present not awaited); only painted frames counted (the frame clock paints only when a mounted batch/scroll invalidated widgets, and a tick callback alone paints nothing). Rust components run on the NSH engine thread, GTK on the main thread, batches hop once per commit. Warm-up 2 s excluded. GSK_RENDERER=cairo.
